status: Design exploration only; 11 identities checked across both sheets; no runtime integration or rigging verification.
fullBodyPrompt:
StockWars NPC animal design exploration, not final runtime assets. Create polished clean 2D cartoon game concept illustration, warm dark outlines, crisp uncluttered color shapes, modest soft cel shading, readable small silhouettes. Non pixel art. Match the existing dog and black cat references' small bipedal animals, large head small torso short limbs, no clothing or shoes, no human hair, no accessories. All characters adults by expression/personality, not realistic wildlife, no human faces. Existing town uses RPG top-down and interiors isometric; this is a neutral front/three-quarter design review sheet only, not a promise of projection compatibility or finished rigs. Rigging reference image is STRUCTURE ONLY, do not copy its humans, outfits, colors or proportions. Atlas references are morphology and clarity references only, no animation requested.
Exactly eleven unique NPC identities in this exact reading order:
1 ANNA: female antlerless doe, warm reddish tan coat cream muzzle, green eyes, calm intelligent composed caring expression, narrow elegant muzzle, no antlers.
2 SHYLOCK: green crocodile, stocky, broad elongated muzzle, calculating polite menacing smile, unmistakable crocodilian features.
3 AGENT K: Russian Blue cat, solid blue-gray fur, vivid green eyes, tapered angular face, tall pointed ears, narrow sharp cool analytical gaze, disciplined upright posture; NOT round sweet black cat.
4 ANDRE: red fox, russet orange coat cream muzzle chest black paws ear tips, narrow sly smiling eyes, relaxed charming unreadable demeanor, bushy white tipped tail.
5 SOPHIA: owl, warm taupe/cream plumage round facial disc, thoughtful quiet intelligent gaze.
6 JULIAN: beaver, brown coat cream muzzle, small incisors and flat broad tail, refined proud aesthetically sensitive expression.
7 CLAIRE: white longhaired cat, voluminous well-groomed fur, elegant aloof expression, lavender-blue eyes, distinctly different from Agent K.
8 VIVIAN: squirrel, chestnut fur cream belly large curled bushy tail, brisk confident practical no-nonsense expression.
9 BARTER: magpie, black-white plumage subtle blue wing accent, pointed dark beak, shrewd appraising gaze, distinguish from owl and bat.
10 PARK: wild boar, broad sturdy brown body, broad snout small tusks angular brows, gruff dependable stern expression.
11 SHADOW: bat, charcoal plum/purple-gray fur, large bat ears and small wing arms, secretive reserved expression, wings subtly folded; no hood.
Use exact English name labels, clean restrained typography. Pale warm ivory background, evenly separated cells, no scene, no watermark, no decorative props. Consistent species colors and identities.
Deliverable 1: FULL-BODY CHARACTER LINEUP SHEET. Landscape high resolution sheet, heading "STOCKWARS / NPC CHARACTER CONCEPTS". Two spacious rows: first six characters, then five centered, each one shown exactly once, complete head ears limbs feet tail within its cell. Front or gentle three-quarter neutral standing pose with visible both feet, similar overall scale, wide comfortable margins, natural species appendages. Name label under each. Full bodies ONLY, no portraits, no expression variants, no motion, no turnaround duplicates. All eleven must appear.
